headline: Godcrofts Leads Renewed Strategic Tumult
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the struggle tightening around a handful of strategic fronts. Godcrofts is now the busiest field, with 72 base events in 24 hours and 20 in the latest two-hour window; all nine bases remain Colonial-held despite the heavy turnover. Fisherman’s Row has reached 39 daily events, though none were recorded in the latest two hours, and its nine bases remain Colonial-held. Stlican Shelf records 28 events and remains divided five Warden to four Colonial, with three fresh events in two hours. Stonecradle also shows 28 events and a five-to-four split, but no event has appeared in the latest six hours. Weathered Expanse has 29 events, with three Warden, six Colonial and no neutral bases; casualty rates remain high, though the latest two-hour activity is quiet. Farranac Coast has become another active pressure point, recording five events in two hours and eight across the day, with one Warden base, nine Colonial bases and one neutral position. Linn Mercy remains bloodied but quieter, at 17 daily events and no recent two-hour turnover.
